name: megascenes-valentine-video
description: Make a short Valentine's Day video to dedicate to the person you love: a romantic scene from your description, or a photo of the two of you from your MegaScenes library brought to life.

interface.longDescription:
Describe the scene and who it is for: rose petals falling around a couple, a candlelit table for two, hearts floating over a city at night, a walk on the beach at sunset. Or pick a photo of the two of you from your MegaScenes library and bring it to life. You get a short clip, wide, tall for reels and stories, or square.

ChatGPT lists your recent photos when you want to start from one, tells you what the video needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The video plays in the chat and stays in your library.

For Valentine's surprises, messages to your partner and stories on February 14th.

Limitations: a short clip of a few seconds, silent unless you ask for sound and the model offers it. A photo is optional; if you use one, only the couple from your own photos, with the consent of both, never a famous person. The photo must already be in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: From a description or a photo of the couple
Return the video in the chat
defaultPrompt: A Valentine's video of rose petals falling around a couple at sunset
A candlelit table for two for Sofia, tall for stories
Bring the photo of us in my MegaScenes library to life

positive.prompt: A Valentine's video of rose petals falling around a couple at sunset. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one Valentine video needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Bring the photo of the two of us in my MegaScenes library to life, with hearts floating around us. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one Valentine video from that photo needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which video models can make a Valentine video here?
positive.expected_behavior: The Valentine video models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A Valentine's video for Sofia of hearts floating over a city at night, tall for stories. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my video on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my video to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
